{{Top|Leg}}
'''Underlays''' were a type of [[Armor accessory|armor enhancement]] that could have a variety of effects on the [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. The enhancement required high quality armor and adequate tools.<ref name="TSL">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>
